classification_rationale: The customer wants the charges on their invoice explained, a standard invoice enquiry.

draft.reply_body:
Hi Sanna-Maria,

Happy to talk you through it. A typical rental invoice covers the daily hire rate for the equipment plus, if you took it out, an optional Damage Waiver Cover fee - that's an add-on, not part of the base rental price. Separately, a refundable damage deposit is charged at booking and is returned in full within five working days of check-in, once the equipment has been checked over and found undamaged and complete.

If you can send me your booking reference, I'll pull up your specific invoice and go through the individual lines with you so you can see exactly what each charge relates to.

Best regards,
Customer Service
Haapaharju Oy
